
{{alias}}( x, alpha, beta )
    Evaluates the cumulative distribution function (CDF) for a log-logistic
    distribution with scale parameter `alpha` and shape parameter `beta`
    at a value `x`.

    If provided `alpha <= 0` or `beta <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    If `x <= 0`, the function returns `0`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    alpha: number
        Scale parameter.

    beta: number
        Shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Evaluated CDF.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 2.0, 1.0, 1.0 )
    ~0.667
    > y = {{alias}}( 4.0, 2.0, 3.0 )
    ~0.889
    > y = {{alias}}( -1.0, 1.0, 1.0 )
    0.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.0, 1.0, 1.0 )
    0.0
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN, 1.0, 1.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0, NaN, 1.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0, 1.0, NaN )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0, -1.0, 1.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0, 1.0, -1.0 )
    NaN


{{alias}}.factory( alpha, beta )
    Returns a function for evaluating the cumulative distribution function
    (CDF) of a log-logistic distribution with scale parameter `alpha`
    and shape parameter `beta`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    alpha: number
        Scale parameter.

    beta: number
        Shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    cdf: Function
        Cumulative distribution function (CDF).

    Examples
    --------
    > var myCDF = {{alias}}.factory( 1.0, 1.0 );
    > var y = myCDF( 2.0 )
    ~0.667

    See Also
    --------
